an3.18:1.1: Sace vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:--
an3.18:1.2: devalokūpapattiyā āvuso samaṇo Gotamo brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti.
an3.18:1.3: Na nu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ puṭṭhā aṭṭiyeyyātha harāyeyyātha jiguccheyyāthā ti?
an3.18:1.5: Iti kira tumhe bhikkhave dibbena āyunā aṭṭiyatha harāyatha jigucchatha dibbena vaṇṇena dibbena sukhena dibbena yasena dibbenādhipateyyena aṭṭiyatha harāyatha jigucchatha
an3.18:1.6: pag eva kho pana bhikkhave tumhehi kāyaduccaritena aṭṭiyitabbaṃ harāyitabbaṃ jigucchitabbaṃ vacīduccaritena . . . manoduccaritena aṭṭiyitabbaṃ harāyitabbaṃ jigucchitabban
